summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital Ltd (formerly Fidelis Insurance Holdings) furnished a Form 6-K with a press release, financial statements, and presentation for Q2 2026 results. The filing covers earnings, underwriting performance (combined ratio 99.5% Q2, 93.1% H1), book value per share of $26.56, and capital returns including $60.1 million in share repurchases at $21.60 per share and $12.5 million in dividends during Q2. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation event. No strategic actions, transactions, or corporate changes are announced; the company continues its ordinary capital-return program.
